table.name: TLGNC_SHIPTO_TRUCK_TYPE
table.description: Priorities with which certain truck types should be preferred or forbidden for a certain shipto. A shipto may have a restriction against big trucks (because the access road has a small weight limit, or because there is not enough space to turn with a trailer), or the customer or carrier has an explicit preference for certain types (if available/possible), maybe because it causes less costs. . If the ship-to has absolutely no entries in this table all cement truck types are possible, but with least priority (e.g. 100), if it has at least one entry in this table the not listed truck types and prio = 0 truck types are forbidden for the shipto. The priorities may be tuned by the order management together with the dispatcher in order to best fulfill the customer's wishes on truck types over all customers/orders. In contrast to the wagon_type priorities, these priorities mainly have an informational purpose for the truck disposition, which is performed manually by the dispatcher. See also table description tlgnc_shsarea_restr_truck_type , tlgnc_order_truck_type.

column.name: SHIPTO_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_shipto. Shipto for which this truck-type restriction is applicable.

column.name: TRUCK_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_truck_type_cd. Type of the truck: 2-axle, 3-axle, 4-axle, 5-axle or semi-trailer truck (Sattelschlepper).

column.name: EVALUATION_PRIORITY
column.description: Priority hints to evaluate possible truck types for this shipto. 0: Forbidden. 1 has priority over 2, which has priority over 3 etc. Truck types which do not have an explicit entry in this table should be treated as possible, but with least priority (e.g. 100). 0=Forbidden is strict, but the other values are only priority-hints. If they can be respected or not depends on the disponent and availability of trucks and knowledge about other orders which should also be ideally dispatched. This prioritization is more important for wagons (i.e. rail disposition) than for trucks, see also tlgnc_shipto_wagon.
